hypotheses.rationale: casaFiesta mirrors brookside's settlement pattern but with the policy adoption and sign posting performed rather than filed as obligations. Test whether a mutually agreed settlement document plus performance of the settlement conducts (adoptPolicy, post) grounds the corresponding obligation (and via h1 the correlative right, and via obligationCompliance compliance). Restricted to these conducts to avoid catching the agree act itself on brookside.
hypotheses.text:
rule settledPolicyAdoption(a1, a2, doc, x, subject, object, beneficiary, authority, effective, t) =
    Act(a1, subject, agree, doc, beneficiary, authority, effective) @ t
    & Act(a2, beneficiary, agree, doc, subject, authority, effective) @ t
    & Act(x, subject, adoptPolicy, object, beneficiary, authority, effective) @ t
    <= obligation(x, subject, adoptPolicy, object, beneficiary, authority, effective) @ t

rule settledPosting(a1, a2, doc, x, subject, object, beneficiary, authority, effective, t) =
    Act(a1, subject, agree, doc, beneficiary, authority, effective) @ t
    & Act(a2, beneficiary, agree, doc, subject, authority, effective) @ t
    & Act(x, subject, post, object, beneficiary, authority, effective) @ t
    <= obligation(x, subject, post, object, beneficiary, authority, effective) @ t
